name: QueryContent

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The namespace. Default value: public.

You can create a namespace by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html operation and query the list of namespaces by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html接口创建，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The name of the document collection.

The document collection is created by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618448.html operation. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618452.html operation to query existing document collections
parameters.help_zh:
文档库名称。

由https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618448.html接口创建。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618452.html接口查看已经创建的文档库
parameters.name: collection

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The password of the namespace.

This value is specified by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

本值为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html接口指定
parameters.name: namespace_password

parameters.help_en: The text content used for retrieval
parameters.help_zh: 用于检索的文本内容
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition for the data to query, in SQL WHERE clause format. The expression returns a Boolean value (true or false). Conditions can be simple comparison operators such as equal to (=), not equal to (<> or !=), greater than (>), less than (<), greater than or equal to (>=), and less than or equal to (<=). Conditions can also be more complex expressions combined with logical operators (AND, OR, NOT), as well as conditions using IN, BETWEEN, and LIKE keywords.


For detailed syntax, refer to: https://www.postgresqltutorial.com/postgresql-tutorial/postgresql-where/
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的数据的过滤条件，格式为SQL的WHERE格式。是一个返回布尔值（真或假）的表达式，条件可以是简单的比较运算符，如等于(=)、不等于(<>或!=)、大于(>), 小于(<)、大于等于(>=)、小于等于(<=)，也可以是逻辑运算符（AND, OR, NOT）组合的更复杂的表达式，以及使用IN、BETWEEN、LIKE等关键字的条件。


详细语法可参考：https://www.postgresqltutorial.com/postgresql-tutorial/postgresql-where/
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The recall window. When this value is not empty, the context of the retrieval results is also returned. The format is a 2-element array: List<A, B>, where -10<=A<=0 and 0<=B<=10.
Use this parameter when documents are split into overly small chunks and retrieval may lose contextual information.
Reranking takes priority over windowing, meaning reranking is performed first, followed by windowing
parameters.help_zh:
召回窗口。当该值不为空时，增加返回检索结果的上下文。格式为2个元素的数组：List<A, B>，其中-10<=A<=0，0<=B<=10。
推荐当文档切分过碎、检索可能会丢失上下文信息时使用该参数。
重排优先窗口化，即先rerank，再窗口化处理
parameters.name: recall_window

parameters.help_en: The number of top results to return
parameters.help_zh: 返回top数量的结果
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en:
The reranking factor. When this value is not empty, the vector retrieve results are reranked. Valid values: 1 < RerankFactor <= 5.
Reranking is slower when documents are sparsely chunked.
The total number of items to rerank (TopK × Factor, rounded up) should not exceed 50
parameters.help_zh:
重排因子。当该值不为空时，会对向量检索结果再做一次重排。取值范围：1<RerankFactor<=5。
当文档切分稀疏时，重排效率慢。
建议重排个数（TopK*Factor（向上取整））不超过50
parameters.name: rerank_factor

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Specifies whether to use full-text retrieve (dual-path recall). Default value: false, which indicates that only vector retrieve is used
parameters.help_zh: （参数废弃）是否使用全文检索（双路召回）。默认为false，仅采用向量检索
parameters.name: use_full_text_retrieval

parameters.help_en:
The similarity algorithm used during retrieval. If this value is empty, the algorithm specified when the knowledge base was created is used. Leave this parameter empty unless you have specific requirements.

Valid values:
l2: Euclidean distance.
ip: inner product distance.
cosine: cosine similarity
parameters.help_zh:
检索时的相似度算法。此值为空时则采用创建知识库时指定的算法，建议如无特殊需求不需设置。

取值说明：
l2：欧氏距离。
ip：点积（内积）距离。
cosine：余弦相似度
parameters.name: metrics

parameters.help_en:
The name of the source image file to search in image-to-image search scenarios.

The image file must have a file extension. Currently supported image extensions: bmp, jpg, jpeg, png, and tiff
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图场景中，待搜索的图片源文件名。

图片文件必须带有文件后缀，当前支持的图片后缀：bmp、jpg、jpeg、png、 tiff
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The publicly accessible URL of the image file in image-to-image search scenarios.

The image file must have a file extension. Currently supported image extensions: bmp, jpg, jpeg, png, and tiff
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图场景中，公网可访问的图片文件URL地址。

图片文件必须带有文件后缀，当前支持的图片后缀：bmp、jpg、jpeg、png、tiff
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return vectors. Default value: false.
false: Does not return vectors.
true: Returns vectors
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回向量。默认为false。
false：不返回向量。
true：返回向量
parameters.name: include_vector

parameters.help_en:
The multi-channel recall algorithm. Default value: empty (scores from dense vectors and full-text retrieve are directly compared and sorting is performed).

Valid values:

RRF: Reciprocal rank fusion. A parameter k controls the fusion effect. For more information, see the HybridSearchArgs configuration.
Weight: Weighted sorting. Parameters control the score weights of vector retrieve and full-text retrieve results before sorting. For more information, see the HybridSearchArgs configuration.
Cascaded: Full-text retrieve is performed first, followed by vector retrieve on the full-text retrieve results
parameters.help_zh:
多路召回算法，默认为空(即直接将稠密向量和全文的分数比较并排序)。

可选值：

RRF：倒数排序融合(Reciprocal rank fusion)，有一个参数k控制融合效果，详见HybridSearchArgs配置；
Weight：比重排序，采用参数控制向量和全文的分数比重，然后再排序，参数详见 HybridSearchArgs 配置；
Cascaded：先全文检索再在其基础上进行向量检索；
parameters.name: hybrid_search
hybrid_search_args

parameters.help_en: The metadata fields to return, separated by commas. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: 默认为空，表示要返回的metadata字段，多个字段用逗号分隔
parameters.name: include_metadata_fields

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously return the URL of the document. By default, the URL is not returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步返回文档的链接地址，默认不返回
parameters.name: include_file_url

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the returned image URL.

Valid values:
Supports seconds (s) and days (d) as units. For example, 300s indicates a validity period of 300 seconds, and 60d indicates a validity period of 60 days.
Valid values: 60s to 365d.
Default value: 7200s (2 hours)
parameters.help_zh:
返回图片URL的有效期。

取值说明
支持以秒（s）和日（d）为单位。例如300s代表链接有效期为300秒，60d代表链接有效期为60天。
取值范围在60s ~ 365d之间。
默认值：7200s，即2小时
parameters.name: url_expiration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable knowledge graph enhancement. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启知识图谱增强。默认值：false
parameters.name: graph_enhance

fields.help_en: The number of top entities and relationship edges to return. Default value: 60
fields.help_zh: 返回top数量的实体和关系边。默认值：60
fields.name: graph_topk

parameters.help_en: The knowledge graph retrieval parameters
parameters.help_zh: 知识图谱检索参数
parameters.name: graph_search_args

fields.help_en: The rerank model name. Valid values: qwen3-rerank, gte-rerank-v2
fields.name: name

fields.example: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
fields.help_en: This parameter can be set when RerankModel.Name is qwen3-rerank. Specifies a custom sorting task type description that guides the model to adopt different sorting strategies
fields.help_zh:
当RerankModel.Name为qwen3-rerank时可设置。
添加自定义排序任务类型说明，通过该参数可以指导模型采用不同的排序策略
fields.name: instruct

parameters.help_en: The rerank model parameters
parameters.help_zh: 重排模型参数
parameters.name: rerank_model

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Default value: empty.

The field must belong to metadata or a default field in the table such as id. Supported formats:

Single field, such as chunk_id.
Multiple fields separated by commas, such as block_id, chunk_id.
Descending order, such as block_id DESC, chunk_id DESC
parameters.help_zh:
默认为空，表示排序的依据字段。

字段必须属于 metadata 或表里的默认字段比如 id，格式支持：

单个字段，如 chunk_id；
多个字段，用逗号连接，如 block_id, chunk_id；
支持反序，如: block_id DESC, chunk_id DESC；
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The offset for paging query
parameters.help_zh: 偏移量，用于分页查询
parameters.name: offset

EmbeddingTokens.description_en:
The number of tokens used during vectorization.

A token is the smallest unit into which the input text is split. A token can be a word, a phrase, a punctuation mark, or a character

token是指将输入的文本分割成的最小单位；token可以是一个单词、一个词组、一个标点符号、一个字符等
